# American Snow & Ice Solutions — factual site summary

American Snow & Ice Solutions is a commercial and industrial snow and ice management company headquartered at 4531 Lehigh Drive, Walnutport, Pennsylvania 18088. It is part of Piechota Group LLC alongside American Property Solutions.

The Piechota family began snow-plowing work in the early 1980s after Greg and Mark Piechota opened Piechota Brothers in Bethlehem in 1975. Michael Piechota joined as a second-generation snowplow operator in 1991. The family expanded its commercial snow capabilities in 1998 and welcomed a third generation in 2016. The organization now focuses on year-round property maintenance with snow and ice management as its primary winter operation.

## Services

Commercial snow plowing includes property-specific routing, extended-wing and V-plows, containment plows, loaders, roving supervisors, and priority-based clearance planning.

De-icing and salting includes pre-treatment generally planned 12–24 hours before a winter event when conditions allow, temperature-aware product selection, applications during events, and post-event treatment.

Sidewalk and walkway service uses dedicated compact equipment and crews for entrances, pedestrian routes, ramps, stairs, crossings, and other priority walking areas.

Weather reporting combines professional forecast information, field observations, geo-fenced service records, before-and-after documentation, and certified post-event reporting.

Winter risk management begins with property review and prioritizes operating hours, employee and customer access, delivery areas, loading zones, traffic flow, and other business-continuity requirements.

## Customers and properties

The company focuses on commercial and industrial work, including warehouses, distribution and logistics facilities, retail and shopping centers, medical and healthcare properties, office and corporate campuses, and multi-site portfolios.

## Coverage

The primary region includes eastern Pennsylvania, western New Jersey, southern New York, and northern Delaware. Pennsylvania communities referenced by the company include Allentown, Bethlehem, Easton, Nazareth, Northampton, Walnutport, Whitehall, Center Valley, Fogelsville, Macungie, Emmaus, Coopersburg, Quakertown, Kutztown, Reading, Pottstown, Palmerton, Lehighton, Hazleton, Jim Thorpe, Bangor, Wind Gap, New Tripoli, and Orefield. Coverage can expand through the company’s service partner network.
